primary.title: Higher social security payouts for Americans in 2027 may put the retirement programme at risk — Here's how
primary.summary: US President Donald Trump's policies have pushed up inflation, which has increased the potential social security payouts for Americans in 2027, and threatened to put the US' retirement programme at risk.
